seams.name: Dun Morogh - Loch Modan south pass

limitations: Approximate centerlines and selected open-ground corridors reviewed from map artwork, not collision data or live NPC positions.
Zone handoffs and passages are explicit but not traced inside tunnels: no solid terrain line on those segments.
Undercity coverage is the surface entrance only. Interior floors, lifts, tower stairs and many building interiors are not mapped.
Shendralas and Hyjal have separate road sections; missing connections remain unverified. No fabricated straight road joins.
No hostile-NPC warning layer yet. Faction-owned access branches are filtered; open roads are not guaranteed safe.
